title: Humanlike AI Design Increases Anthropomorphism but Yields Divergent Outcomes on Engagement and Trust Globally
reasoning: The research explicitly evaluates 'moral' and 'soul' as key attributes in its study of AI anthropomorphism. Furthermore, it incorporates an analysis of how religious traditions (specifically Japanese Buddhist traditions) influence the attribution of human characteristics to non-human objects, making moral and spiritual concepts a central component of its cross-cultural psychological evaluation.
